# ShinyItemAnalysis

Test and item analysis via shiny

## Overview

**ShinyItemAnalysis** is an R package including functions and
interactive shiny application for the psychometric analysis of
educational tests, psychological assessments, health-related and other
types of multi-item measurements, or ratings from multiple raters.
Offered methods include:

- Exploration of total and standard scores
- Analysis of correlation structure and validity
- Analysis of measurement error and reliability
- Traditional item analysis
- Item analysis with regression models
- Item analysis with IRT models
- Detection of differential item functioning
- … and more via add-on modules

![](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/patriciamar/ShinyItemAnalysis/.readme_assets/scrSIAintro.png)![](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/patriciamar/ShinyItemAnalysis/.readme_assets/scrSIAdif.png)

Number of toy datasets is available, the interactive application also
allows the users to upload and analyze their own data and to
automatically generate PDF or HTML reports.

**ShinyItemAnalysis** is available online at [Czech Academy of
Sciences](https://shiny.cs.cas.cz/ShinyItemAnalysis/) and
[shinyapps.io](https://cemp.shinyapps.io/ShinyItemAnalysis/). It can be
also downloaded from
[**CRAN**](https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=ShinyItemAnalysis). Visit
our [**web page**](https://shinyitemanalysis.org/) about
ShinyItemAnalysis to learn more!

## Installation

The easiest way to get **ShinyItemAnalysis** is to install it from CRAN:

``` r

install.packages("ShinyItemAnalysis")
```

*Click here for more information about installing versions 1.4.0+*

From **ShinyItemAnalysis** version 1.4.0 on, only the most necessary
package dependencies are installed out of the box. You may be prompted
later on to install additional packages ensuring a smooth run of the
interactive application. To install everything straight out, use rather:

``` r

install.packages("ShinyItemAnalysis", dependencies = TRUE)
```

Or you can get the newest development version from GitHub:

``` r

if(!require(remotes)) install.package("remotes")
remotes::install_github("patriciamar/ShinyItemAnalysis")
```

## Version

The table below summarizes the currently available versions of
**ShinyItemAnalysis** across different distribution sources,
distinguishing between sources that provide both the R package and the
Shiny application and those that provide the application only.

| Source | Type | Version |
|:---|:---|:---|
| [CRAN](https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=ShinyItemAnalysis) | Package & App | 1.6.0 |
| [GitHub (development)](https://github.com/patriciamar/ShinyItemAnalysis) | Package & App | 1.6.0 |
| [Czech Academy of Sciences](https://shiny.cs.cas.cz/ShinyItemAnalysis/) | Online app only | 1.6.0 |
| [shinyapps.io](https://cemp.shinyapps.io/ShinyItemAnalysis/) | Online app only | 1.6.0 |

## Usage

It is very easy to run **ShinyItemAnalysis** in `R`:

``` r

ShinyItemAnalysis::run_app()
# or
ShinyItemAnalysis::startShinyItemAnalysis()
```

Or if you are an RStudio IDE user, simply click on
`Run ShinyItemAnalysis` in
[Addins](https://docs.posit.co/ide/user/ide/guide/productivity/add-ins.html)
menu (located at the end of the toolbar). Last but not least, you can
also try the app directly online at [Czech Academy of
Sciences](https://shiny.cs.cas.cz/ShinyItemAnalysis/) or
[shinyapps.io](https://cemp.shinyapps.io/ShinyItemAnalysis/)!

## References

When using **ShinyItemAnalysis** software, we appreciate if you include
a reference in your publications. To cite the software, please, use:

> Martinková P., & Hladká A. (2023) Computational Aspects of
> Psychometric Methods: With R. (1st ed.). Chapman and Hall/CRC. [doi:
> 10.1201/9781003054313](https://doi.org/10.1201/9781003054313). ISBN
> 9781003054313.

> Martinková P., & Drabinová A. (2018) ShinyItemAnalysis for teaching
> psychometrics and to enforce routine analysis of educational tests.
> The R Journal, 10(2), 503-515. [doi:
> 10.32614/RJ-2018-074](https://doi.org/10.32614/RJ-2018-074).

When using one of the **SIA modules**, please, cite:

> Martinková P., Netík J. & Hladká A. (2026) Enhancing Psychometric
> Analysis with Interactive SIA Modules. Psychometrika, Online First,
> 1-29. [doi:
> 10.1017/psy.2026.10088](https://doi.org/10.1017/psy.2026.10088).

## Getting help and providing feedback

If you meet any issue with **ShinyItemAnalysis** interactive application
or its modules, contact us directly at <sia-group@cs.cas.cz>. In case
you meet any trouble with ShinyItemAnalysis R package, please report as
an issue on
[GitHub](https://github.com/patriciamar/ShinyItemAnalysis/issues). We
warmly encourage you to provide your feedback using the [Google
form](https://forms.gle/b6KQLMxzjqebcRhq6).

# Package index

## All functions

- [`AIBS`](AIBS.md) : AIBS grant peer review scoring dataset

- [`Anxiety`](Anxiety.md) : PROMIS Anxiety Scale Dataset

- [`AttitudesExpulsion`](AttitudesExpulsion.md) : Attitudes towards the
  Expulsion of the Sudeten Germans (dataset)

- [`BFI2`](BFI2.md) : BFI2 Dataset

- [`BlisClass-class`](BlisClass-class.md) : BLIS S4 class

- [`CLoSEread6`](CLoSEread6.md) : Czech Longitudinal Study in Education
  (CLoSE) - reading in 6th grade

- [`CZmatura`](CZmatura.md) : CZmatura dataset

- [`CZmaturaS`](CZmaturaS.md) : CZmatura dataset - sample

- [`DDplot()`](DDplot.md) : Plot difficulties and discriminations/item
  validity

- [`DistractorAnalysis()`](DistractorAnalysis.md) : Distractor analysis

- [`EPIA`](EPIA.md) : The Eysenck Personality Inventory Impulsivity
  Subscale

- [`GMAT`](GMAT.md) : Dichotomous dataset based on GMAT with the same
  total score distribution for groups.

- [`HCI`](HCI.md) : Homeostasis Concept Inventory dichotomous dataset

- [`HCIdata`](HCIdata.md) : Homeostasis concept inventory full dataset

- [`HCIgrads`](HCIgrads.md) : Homeostasis concept inventory dataset of
  graduate students

- [`HCIkey`](HCIkey.md) : Key of correct answers for homeostasis concept
  inventory dataset

- [`HCIlong`](HCIlong.md) : Homeostasis Concept Inventory in a long
  format

- [`HCIprepost`](HCIprepost.md) : Homeostasis concept inventory pretest
  and posttest scores

- [`HCItest`](HCItest.md) : Homeostasis concept inventory
  multiple-choice dataset

- [`HCItestretest`](HCItestretest.md) : Homeostasis concept inventory
  test-retest dataset

- [`HeightInventory`](HeightInventory.md) : Height inventory dataset

- [`ICCrestricted()`](ICCrestricted.md) : Range-restricted reliability
  with intra-class correlation

- [`ItemAnalysis()`](ItemAnalysis.md) : Compute traditional item
  analysis indices

- [`LearningToLearn`](LearningToLearn.md) : Dichotomous dataset of
  learning to learn test

- [`MSATB`](MSATB.md) : Dichotomous dataset of Medical School Admission
  Test in Biology.

- [`MSclinical`](MSclinical.md) : Clinical outcomes in multiple
  sclerosis patients dataset

- [`NIH`](NIH.md) : NIH grant peer review scoring dataset

- [`ShinyItemAnalysis`](ShinyItemAnalysis-package.md)
  [`ShinyItemAnalysis-package`](ShinyItemAnalysis-package.md) :
  ShinyItemAnalysis: Test and Item Analysis via Shiny

- [`ShinyItemAnalysis_options`](ShinyItemAnalysis_options.md) : Options
  consulted by ShinyItemAnalysis

- [`TestAnxietyCor`](TestAnxietyCor.md) : Correlation matrix for the
  test anxiety dataset

- [`coef(`*`<BlisClass>`*`)`](coef-BlisClass-method.md) : Get
  Coefficients from a fitted BLIS model

- [`dataMedical`](dataMedical.md) : Dichotomous dataset of admission
  test to medical school

- [`dataMedicalgraded`](dataMedicalgraded.md) : Graded dataset of
  admission test to medical school

- [`dataMedicalkey`](dataMedicalkey.md) : Key of correct answers for
  dataset of admission test to medical school

- [`dataMedicaltest`](dataMedicaltest.md) : Dataset of admission test to
  medical school

- [`fa_parallel()`](fa_parallel.md) : Conduct Parallel Analysis

- [`fit_blis()`](fit_blis.md) [`blis()`](fit_blis.md) : Fit
  Baseline-category Logit Intercept-Slope (BLIS) model on nominal data

- [`gDiscrim()`](gDiscrim.md) : Compute generalized item discrimination

- [`get_orig_levels()`](get_orig_levels.md) : Get Original Levels from a
  Fitted BLIS model

- [`ggWrightMap()`](ggWrightMap.md) :

  Plot person-item map (Wright map) using `ggplot2`

- [`nominal_to_int()`](nominal_to_int.md) : Turn nominal (factor) data
  to integers, keep original levels with a key of correct responses
  alongside

- [`obtain_nrm_def()`](obtain_nrm_def.md) :

  Obtain model definition for `mirt`'s nominal model taking in account
  the key of correct answers

- [`plot(`*`<sia_parallel>`*`)`](plot.sia_parallel.md) : Plot Method for
  Parallel Analysis Output

- [`plotAdjacent()`](plotAdjacent.md) : Plot category probabilities of
  adjacent category logit model

- [`plotCumulative()`](plotCumulative.md) : Plot cumulative and category
  probabilities of cumulative logit model

- [`plotDIFLogistic()`](plotDIFLogistic.md) : Function for
  characteristic curve of 2PL logistic DIF model

- [`plotDIFirt()`](plotDIFirt.md) : Plot item characteristic curve of
  DIF IRT model

- [`plotDistractorAnalysis()`](plotDistractorAnalysis.md) : Plot item
  distractor analysis

- [`plotMultinomial()`](plotMultinomial.md) : Plot category
  probabilities of multinomial model

- [`plot_corr()`](plot_corr.md) : Compute and plot an item correlation
  matrix

- [`print(`*`<blis_coefs>`*`)`](print.blis_coefs.md) : Print method for
  BLIS coefficients

- [`recode_nr()`](recode_nr.md) : Recognize and recode not-reached
  responses

- [`startShinyItemAnalysis()`](startShinyItemAnalysis.md)
  [`run_app()`](startShinyItemAnalysis.md) : Start ShinyItemAnalysis
  application

- [`theme_app()`](theme_app.md) :

  Complete theme for `ShinyItemAnalysis` graphics
